description: Canonical source of truth for Nexum reserved-model policy. Models listed here are internal_only (reserved for the Hormiguero) and are filtered from user-facing surfaces (/modelo, /proveedor model lists, Resolver recommendations). They remain available in Ollama for internal Hormiguero callers. This file is the single source; the Rust /modelo filter (peri-tui/src/app/model_panel.rs DEFAULT_RESERVED_INTERNAL_MODELS), the Provider Resolver, and the Provider Catalog all mirror it. Updated: 2026-07-03.
policy_principles: A reserved model is NOT a user-facing model.
user_selectable=false => hidden from /modelo and not certifiable as the main runtime model.
visibility=internal_only => not shown as a normal selectable option in /proveedor.
The Hormiguero may use reserved models internally; the user chat runtime may not.
Never delete a reserved model from Ollama; only hide/protect it in Nexum.
If every detected model is reserved and none is user-facing, surface an explicit error (no silent fallback).

reserved_models.reason: Modelo interno reservado para obreros del Hormiguero low-cost; evitar competencia de memoria con runtime principal.
